status: post-audit fail-closed correction; does not authorize outcome-driven threshold tuning

development_split.calibration: first 16 rows in frozen pilot order
development_split.internal_validation: last 16 rows in frozen pilot order

confidence.statistic: negative mean processed token NLL from actual greedy256 generated tokens
confidence.calibrator: deterministic pool-adjacent-violators isotonic regression per model

development_proxy.target: VQA-normalized token F1 >= 0.5 against development reference
development_proxy.role: functional threshold fitting only; never clinical hallucination truth or paper efficacy
development_proxy.threshold_selection: unchanged from v1: minimum empirical error among NLL cutoffs meeting coverage; higher coverage then lower cutoff tie break

claim_action.abstained: set uncertainty=uncertain on each extracted image-grounded claim; do not delete the claim or whole answer
claim_action.unparsed_answer: retain answer unchanged and mark action not_applicable

t2_gate.scope: every model separately; pooled statistics cannot satisfy the gate
t2_gate.calibration_proxy_classes: at least one positive and one negative proxy row per model
